title: P8 numerical qualification campaign
objective: Build backend-neutral P0-P8 corpora, real Sage.js Node adapters, capability binding drafts, fail-closed matrix policy templates, and qualification tests without fabricating platform evidence

oracles: independent mathematical residuals and metamorphic identities computed outside solver status

handoff.summary: Made the source-current P0-P8 campaign release-gate ready without creating platform receipts. The 65-case corpus and 40 available capabilities now execute against the integrated Node/browser-worker artifacts, including current unified cminpack/NLopt cache semantics and SEA parser-guard capability. Historical receipt verification pins the exact subject/platform memory collector tuple and lifecycle cleanup covers collector-rejected successful initialization. Added a checked four-platform hermetic SciPy catalog for CPython 3.14.4, NumPy 2.5.1, and SciPy 1.18.0 plus a source-bound safe tar/wheel provisioner. A real Linux x64 download normalized to the catalog's f8b50254026c... closure (4293 files, 409 directories, 366341985 bytes), created an authenticated runtime binding, and the rebuilt real first-party adapter campaign passed. The full 16-row policy requires one exact per-platform oracle binding and independently verified scipy_execution; evidence remains deliberately absent until the frozen release candidate is measured.
risks: No final Node, npm, SEA, browser, or worker platform receipt was collected. The checked templates stay evidence-free and fail closed until the exact clean candidate is measured on all required hosts and runtimes.

Only Linux x64 was reprovisioned in this lane. The other three exact catalog closures came from the authenticated cross-platform artifact research and must be reprovisioned on the final four-host campaign.

Local npm and SEA adapter cases were skipped because release archives were not supplied; their parser-guard, resource-identity, process-tree, and lifecycle boundaries have focused executable regressions but still require candidate archive receipts.

architecture:check reaches native classification and then fails only because the two existing qualification-only cminpack/NLopt sanitizer harnesses are not yet classified in the shared native registry. Integration owns those entries.
The NLopt production manifest remains pending source-current promotion, so the final release gate is intentionally impossible until the selected Nelder-Mead-only artifact is requalified.

Promote the reviewed selected-source NLopt manifest, provision the exact hermetic oracle on all four persistent hosts, and package the frozen candidate.

Collect and aggregate immutable candidate-bound Node, fresh-npm, relocated-SEA, browser, worker, sanitizer, destructive-Wasm, memory, and structural-performance evidence; release wiring must reject any missing row.
